children: Overview
Germany sportswear maker's preliminary Q3 revenue rose 9% yr/yr to record level
Q3 operating profit grew 37% to record level
Gross margin improved, aided by €200 mln US tariff refund and full-price sales
Co will publish its final set of financial results for Q3 on October 29
Outlook
Adidas expects 2026 currency-neutral revenue growth between 9% and 10%
Company raises 2026 operating profit outlook to around €2.5 bln from €2.3 bln
Adidas to reinvest about €100 mln in Q4 to support future operating leverage
Result Drivers
TARIFF REFUND - €200 mln US tariff refund contributed to gross margin improvement
FULL-PRICE SALES - Healthy full-price sales supported gross margin gains
CURRENCY IMPACT - Unfavorable currency movements negatively affected results
